To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the amplitude of Forbush effect in muon flux is about one third of that for neutron flux, and muon flux asymmetries during Forbush decrease are related with the motion direction of solar plasma cloud.
the Forbush decreases of muon flux are about 1/3 of the corresponding neutron flux decreases and the direction of muon flux decrease anisotropy changes with the solar wind velocity vector.
Forbush decreases are registered by muon hodoscope with amplitude about one third of neutron flux decrease.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of Forbush effect dynamics and its relation to the solar wind structure.
the study of the Forbush effect by means of the muon hodoscope network and the comparison with neutron monitor data.
the development of new techniques of Forbush effect study using the data of muon hodo- scopic detectors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
muon hodoscope is an effective tool for studying the Forbush effect.
the Forbush effect is a real effect and it can be used to study solar wind and its interactions with Earth’s magnetic field.
muon detectors are useful for the investigation of Forbush effect and the study of the rigidity dependence of the Forbush effect is still in progress.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hodoscopes are useful instruments for Forbush effects study.
the Forbush effects are well registered by the muon detectors and they can be used as an additional tool to investigate the Forbush effect dynamics.

Forbush effect in muon flux is a very useful phenomenon for the study of the interplanetary magnetic field structure and its dynamics, as well as for the investigation of cosmic ray propagation in the heliosphere.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the muon hodoscope URAGAN is a new powerful instrument that can be used to study Forbush effects and their connection with the interplanetary and heliospheric phenomena.
the hodoscopes are very useful for studying of Forbush effect dynamics.
the muon hodoscope is able to provide information about the rigidity dependence of the Forbush effect amplitude.
